summary: Extends RSVP-TE to support path keys, which stand in for hidden path segments when paths are computed across multiple domains by cooperating PCEs. It lets setup signaling work without revealing the details of other domains.

eli5.summary: A path key is a token for a hidden part of a route. This note teaches the signaling messages to understand these tokens so connections can still be set up.

questions: how does rsvp support path keys
how to signal paths across domains with confidentiality
